comments.note: BookmarksBrowserViewModel.cs: DebouncedSearchAsync calls ExecuteLoadPageAsync directly, bypassing the LoadPageCommand concurrency guard. A concurrent LoadPageCommand and a debounced search can both execute ExecuteLoadPageAsync simultaneously, writing to Items, CurrentPage, TotalPages, and IsLoading with no mutual exclusion. The ConfigureAwait(false) in DebouncedSearchAsync means continuations run off the UI thread, widening the race window. No data corruption risk — worst case is a momentary stale render. Recommend a future WP add a single-flight guard (e.g. an Interlocked counter, as in MoviesListViewModel._loadingGuard) to ExecuteLoadPageAsync.

BookmarksBrowserViewModel.cs: _externalPlayerService is accepted by the DI constructor and stored in a field, but is never read in this WP. PlayBookmark raises NavigateToMovieRequested instead (correctly, since BookmarkListItem lacks a file path). The unused field creates a mild false expectation in the constructor signature. When the file-path lookup capability lands in a future WP, this field should be wired up or the constructor parameter removed.

BookmarksBrowserViewModelTests.cs: LoadPageCommand_WhenRepositoryIsNull_ItemsRemainsEmpty uses `var sut = new BookmarksBrowserViewModel()` without a `using` block, unlike every other test that uses `using var sut`. Harmless here (design-time constructor holds no disposable resources), but inconsistent with the test file's own convention. Minor — acceptable as-is.

The command is implemented and tested, but the AXAML wiring is intentionally deferred. Document in the View's code-behind or a follow-up WP note that tile-click routing to SelectBookmarkCommand is pending navigation integration.

[documentation-forward] BookmarksBrowserView.axaml: the thumbnail area is a solid-colour Border placeholder — BookmarkListItem.ThumbnailPath is not rendered. Document the stub with a TODO comment in the AXAML and reference the WP that will wire up the Image control.
